taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You mentioned getting little support from your manager. What happened?

My team lead is on calls with Europe all day, so when I get stuck on a billing dispute my Teams message waits until the next morning and the case sits. Yesterday a customer credit note even waited two days because of it.
How does the delayed credit note affect your daily tasks?
It backs up my queue and leaves customers waiting two days for resolution since I can't move forward without approval.
What would help you move forward when approvals are delayed?
A 15-minute fixed slot each day with my lead, or a backup person to ask, would really help me move forward.

Here is what I will tell HR: Manager unavailability causes delays in obtaining approvals for billing disputes and customer credit notes. [MANAGER_SUPPORT] "My team lead is on calls with Europe all day, so when I get stuck on a billing dispute my Teams message waits until the next morning and the case sits."
